mil3.1.16:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, do these qualities, though diverse, accomplish a single purpose?”
mil3.1.16:1.3: “Yes, Great King, these qualities, though diverse, accomplish a single purpose: they destroy the defilements.”
mil3.1.16:2.1: “How, venerable sir, do these qualities, though diverse, accomplish a single purpose and destroy the defilements?
mil3.1.16:2.3: “Just as, Great King, an army, though diverse—elephants, horses, chariots, and foot soldiers—accomplishes a single purpose: it conquers the enemy army in battle;
mil3.1.16:2.4: so too, Great King, these qualities, though diverse, accomplish a single purpose and destroy the defilements.”
mil3.1.16:4.1: The Question on Diverse Qualities Accomplishing a Single Task: Sixteenth.
